answer: Each epoch, an agent deposits bonded stake and evaluates an epoch polynomial, committing the result to its Semaphore identity-tree path through a polynomial identity commitment. RLN rate-limits messages with epoch-bound nullifiers. If the agent sends duplicates, two inconsistent shares enable Shamir secret sharing to reveal its private key; the protocol instantaneously slashes collateral. Lagoon, sonnet, and willow are harmless log labels, not consensus identities.
